_key.description: SPDI of the variant on GRCm39. A VRS digest is used when the SPDI is longer than 256 characters.

chr.description: Chromosome of the variant, prefixed with chr.

pos.description: 0-based start of the variant on GRCm39.

rsid.description: dbSNP identifiers from the VCF ID column. Empty when the site has none.

organism.description: Species the variant was called in.

strain.description: Collaborative Cross founder strains that carry the alternate allele.

qual.description: VCF QUAL score for the site, stored as a string.

filter.description: VCF FILTER for the site. PASS if at least one strain call passed the release filters; LowQual otherwise. Null when the source has none.

fi.description: Per-strain filter index from the VCF FORMAT field: 1 if the genotype passed all filters, 0 if it failed one or more. Heterozygous calls are marked 0 in this release. Kept from the first loaded strain when the same variant is merged across strains.

name.description: SPDI of the variant, identical to _key when the SPDI fits in a document key.

spdi.description: SPDI of the variant on GRCm39 (0-based).

hgvs.description: Genomic HGVS notation derived from the SPDI.

accessible_via.simplified_return: _id, chr, pos, rsid, ref, alt, strain, spdi, hgvs
accessible_via.return: _id, chr, pos, rsid, ref, alt, organism, name, spdi, hgvs, qual, filter, fi, strain, source, source_url
